name: Gulf / US–Iran war
summary: Iran says it downed two US drones over Qeshm; Trump threatens further strikes as tanker attacks continue
state: Iran's Revolutionary Guards said on 5 Nov they brought down two US MQM-170 drones over Qeshm Island, and President Trump said the US may have to destroy the rest of Iran (Anadolu Agency). Iran reported three tankers damaged in the Gulf on 5 Nov and Hormuz traffic was below 60% of normal on 6 Nov (Grafa; Voice of Emirates). Active state-on-state hostilities meet the Alert line.
for_you: Follow FCDO travel advice for the Gulf region; airspace and shipping disruption can change at short notice.
rubric_hit: Active strikes between states and attacks on Gulf shipping = Alert

sources.title: Grafa — Oil prices face 12% weekly drop as Gulf risks persist
Voice of Emirates — Oil prices rise: Brent nears $100, while U.S. crude hits $91.66

why: Direct hostilities between Iran and the US or Israel threaten Gulf energy infrastructure, the Strait of Hormuz and the wider region.
drivers: Strikes and retaliation, attacks on shipping and Gulf states, mediation and ceasefire talks, US force posture.

rubric.alert: Active strikes between states, attacks on Gulf energy infrastructure or shipping, or the Strait of Hormuz substantially closed.
rubric.watch: A ceasefire or stalemate with sporadic strikes, or credible threats of renewed strikes.
rubric.normal: No direct state-on-state hostilities; diplomacy active.
